document.about: Hobart AM15 specification sheet (dealer copy). Its specification page sets two columns of prose under a rule.

notes: 2026-11-24 (#190): each page's title names the model, `DISHWASHER – ELECTRIC` or `DISHWASHER – GAS`, and three pages set `DISHWASHER` alone. Those three were read as a running line, and it was cut out of the other titles, leaving `– ELECTRIC` and `– GAS`.

2026-11-25 (#276): each title is a running head naming the part of the sheet the page is in, flush left on the left-hand pages and flush right on the right-hand ones. It is the heading at its first page and runs on the pages after, so each title is read once, and `DISHWASHER` runs on its later pages without being cut from the longer titles.

checks.issue: #190 kept `DISHWASHER` out of the running lines, so it was a heading on all three of its pages; #276 keeps it once, at its first page.
#190: the title was cut to `– ELECTRIC`.
#190: the title was cut to `– GAS`, an h1.
#276: the title was a heading on both of its pages. (#190: it was once cut to `– ELECTRIC`.)
#276: the title was a heading on both of its pages. (#190: it was once cut to `– GAS`.)
